markdown_content: ## Overview of CLO 2026.1 New Features This document presents a detailed overview of the new features and improvements in CLO 2026.1, focusing on pattern management, knitwear editing, sewing simulation, UI enhancements, grading review, pattern drafting, seam allowance customization, DXF workflow improvements, archive speed, annotation editing, 3D garment folding, volume measurement for accessories, symmetric pinch editing, racing tool updates, glue tool enhancements, custom view saving, multi-auto save backup system, zipper editor improvements, graphic locking, blend shape animation, UV import enhancements, BOM editor updates, nesting workflow improvements, and render enhancements. --- ## Pattern Information Window for 2D CAD Efficiency This section introduces the Pattern Information window, a core enhancement improving 2D CAD work efficiency by providing an intuitive grid view of all 2D patterns with key attributes, including sampling, shearing base, and pattern metadata. It supports version history tracking and easy switching between pattern versions. - **Pattern List and Attributes**: Displays unique item ID, visual mini preview, and editable pattern name. - **Pattern Classification**: Enables classification by type (shell, lining, facing, binding, necktape, sleeve head, piping) via preset drop-downs for precise production definitions. - **Fabric Assignment**: Easily view and change fabric applied to each pattern piece. - **Pattern Properties**: - Gray Line: Adjust pattern unit size. - Shrinkage: Adjust horizontal and vertical fabric contraction. - Mirror Axis: Automatically set from symmetrical data; can be manually changed after unlinking symmetry. - **Cut Amount**: Automatically linked to pattern quantity; can manually set the number of columns. - **Description Field**: Record design notes, sewing guidelines for clear team communication. - **Work Stage Tracking**: Define pattern development stage (Draft, Editing, Production). - **Version History**: Save and restore pattern states via History button, enabling flexible design iteration. --- ## Knit Swatch Editor Enhancements for Advanced Knit Design This update introduces new stitch types (tuck, transfer, cable) and an improved Knit Swatch Editor divided into a real-time preview window and a setting panel, facilitating intricate knitwear design and simulation. - **UI Improvements**: - Flat View mode to preview knit swatches flattened (simulation disabled in this mode). - Immediate preview updates upon parameter changes (weight, cost). - **Simulation Controls**: - Horizontal and vertical tension adjustments control knit contraction. - Flattening option emphasizes vertical tension or flattens fabric. - **Stitch Editing Tools**: - Select Edit Tool (shortcut S) for single/multiple stitches selection with modifiers (Shift, Alt, Ctrl). - Line selections (horizontal: R, vertical: C, wavy: W). - Area selection via mouse drag with combining or removing selections using Shift or Alt. - **Editing Operations**: - Apply stitch styles via Ctrl + click. - Copy (Ctrl C) and paste (Ctrl V) with stamp preview and Tab key for precise placement. - Symmetrical paste with Ctrl R. - Move, delete (Delete/Backspace), and reset stitches. - **Shortcut Cycling**: Tab key cycles through front knit, back knit, front miss, back miss, and tuck tools. - **New Stitch Types**: - Wales stitch with adjustable repeat size. - Tuck stitch applied to single or multiple stitches. - Transfer tool for moving stitches horizontally, useful for eyelash or lace effects. - Cable tool with adjustable Over/Under stitches, twisted direction, and preview. - **Knit Direction Linking**: Synchronize knit direction with pattern color direction for consistent fabric behavior. - **Position X/Y Properties**: Fine-tune horizontal and vertical repeat positioning of knit swatches for seam alignment. --- ## Simline Lip Tool for Realistic Sewing Line Tearing Simulation The Simline Lip function allows physical simulation of tearing along sewing lines, supporting selective ripping of entire or partial sewing lines. - **Key Features**: - Lips are individual objects linked to sewing lines, enabling selective tearing. - Created in 3D toolbar and 2D pattern window. - Can be added via the Simline Lip tool or right-click menu (Add 19 Lip). - Lip properties include activation toggle, lip resistance threshold (force limit before ripping), and history management. - **Editing Lips**: - Edit Lip tool enables adjustment of rip start/end points and moving lips along sewing lines. - Non-activation mode to fix ripped states temporarily. - **Fray (Prey) Groups**: - Preset fray profiles (denim, cotton, satin) downloadable from the fabric library. - Customizable via four tabs: Common, Puzzle (holes), Loose (stretched threads), Exposed (deeply exposed threads). - Controls include density, thickness, orientation, curl, gravity, and material properties. - **Restoration and Deletion**: - Restore on Deactivation returns lip to original sewing. - Deleting the lip removes rip effects and restores sewing line. --- ## UI Improvements: Toolbar Customization, Right-Click Menu, Global Search This update streamlines UI workflows with three core enhancements: - **Combined 2D/3D Toolbars**: Compact two-line toolbars for more usable screen space. - **Right-Click Pop-Up Menu**: - Tabs and categories for organized access. - Real-time search filtering. - Keyboard navigation with Tab and arrow keys. - **Global Menu Search**: - Single shortcut key to search and execute any menu function quickly. - **Toolbar Customization**: - Group Tool Editor to create and edit tool groups. - Hide/show rarely used tools. - Drag and drop tools between groups or create new groups. - Fixed essential tools (e.g., Simulation button). - Save/load toolbar settings as JSON files. - Real-time toolbar rearrangement on-screen. --- ## Grading Review 2D for Improved Graphic and Pattern Size Comparison Grading Review 2D allows simultaneous comparison of graded graphics and pattern sizes across multiple sizes in a split 2D window. - **Features**: - Side-by-side display of graded sizes (small to XL). - Layout controls similar to Grading Review 3D. - Information display options: - Show Pattern Name - Show Annotation - Show Line Length (pattern outlines) - Show Grain Line (color direction) - Show 2D Measurement (custom measurement lines) - Show Graphic Dimension (width, height, layout position) - **Output**: - Save Snapshot tool exports layout images with transparent background and separate images options. --- ## Pattern Drafter Enhancements with Avatar Size Matching and Detail Blocks The improved Pattern Drafter enables automatic pattern creation matched to the CLO avatar size, with added detailed blocks for versatile design transformations. - **Auto Size Matching**: - Matches parametric patterns to avatar body measurements. - Editable measurements before pattern creation. - **Detail Blocks**: - New neckline types: Crewneck, V-neck, U-neck, Square neck, adjustable curvature. - Pants/Skirts: Yorked jeans without darts, fly, pocket options. - Pockets: Front pocket, kangaroo pocket with adjustable opening curve. - Hood: 2-panel or 3-panel with adjustable size. - **AI Pattern Drafter**: - Supports avatar size matching. - Design suggestions via text prompts. - Generates patterns matching design ideas with detail block combinations. --- ## Custom Seam Allowance and Sample Corner Preset Library This feature improves seam allowance editing for production-ready patterns with extended preset corner types and a custom seam allowance mode. - **User Settings**: - Default seam allowance width (10mm or 0.375 inch). - Seam allowance color updated to light purple (customizable). - **Seam Allowance Tool**: - Activated in 2D toolbar. - Select pattern outline or points to edit seam allowance. - **Eight New Seam Allowance Corner Types**: 1. Extension: Extends corner to crossing end. 2. Perpendicular: Combined vertical options with adjustable crossing direction. 3. Turn-back: Inward fold seam with adjustable fold direction and length. 4. Slant: Diagonal cut line extension, length adjustable. 5. Round: Converts sharp corners to soft curves. 6. Envelope: Adjustable distance extension to create envelope shape. 7. Dart Cap: Improved usability with clear line division and fold direction arrows. 8. Pocket: Suitable for patch pockets with three adjustment options, including double-sided. - **Custom Seam Allowance Mode**: - Freely edit seam allowance points and lines. - Limited to symmetric or half-symmetric patterns. - **Import Behavior**: - External CAD seam lines are automatically recognized as custom seam allowance and locked. - Import options adjusted accordingly. - **Nesting**: - Seam allowance options integrated into nesting workflow. --- ## DXF Import and Export Workflow Improvements Enhancements focus on compatibility and control in DXF file exchange. - **Import Dialog**: - File format must be explicitly selected: DXFAAMA, DXFASTM, STANDARDDXF. - Reduces data distortion and compatibility errors. - New nesting location options for imported patterns: - Seam Allowance only - Pattern Outline only - Both (Boss) - **Export Dialog**: - Combined DXF AAMA option replaces prior duplicates. - Simplified and intuitive naming conventions. - Removes obsolete format and rule file

**Auto Size Matching**: - Matches parametric patterns to avatar body measurements. - Editable measurements before pattern creation. - **Detail Blocks**: - New neckline types: Crewneck, V-neck, U-neck, Square neck, adjustable curvature. - Pants/Skirts: Yorked jeans without darts, fly, pocket options. - Pockets: Front pocket, kangaroo pocket with adjustable opening curve. - Hood: 2-panel or 3-panel with adjustable size. - **AI Pattern Drafter**: - Supports avatar size matching. - Design suggestions via text prompts. - Generates patterns matching design ideas with detail block combinations. --- ## Custom Seam Allowance and Sample Corner Preset Library This feature improves seam allowance editing for production-ready patterns with extended preset corner types and a custom seam allowance mode. - **User Settings**: - Default seam allowance width (10mm or 0.375 inch). - Seam allowance color updated to light purple (customizable). - **Seam Allowance Tool**: - Activated in 2D toolbar. - Select pattern outline or points to edit seam allowance. - **Eight New Seam Allowance Corner Types**: 1. Extension: Extends corner to crossing end. 2. Perpendicular: Combined vertical options with adjustable crossing direction. 3. Turn-back: Inward fold seam with adjustable fold direction and length. 4. Slant: Diagonal cut line extension, length adjustable. 5. Round: Converts sharp corners to soft curves. 6. Envelope: Adjustable distance extension to create envelope shape. 7. Dart Cap: Improved usability with clear line division and fold direction arrows. 8. Pocket: Suitable for patch pockets with three adjustment options, including double-sided. - **Custom Seam Allowance Mode**: - Freely edit seam allowance points and lines. - Limited to symmetric or half-symmetric patterns. - **Import Behavior**: - External CAD seam lines are automatically recognized as custom seam allowance and locked. - Import options adjusted accordingly. - **Nesting**: - Seam allowance options integrated into nesting workflow. --- ## DXF Import and Export Workflow Improvements Enhancements focus on compatibility and control in DXF file exchange. - **Import Dialog**: - File format must be explicitly selected: DXFAAMA, DXFASTM, STANDARDDXF. - Reduces data distortion and compatibility errors.
